title: Star & Share beacon-skill on GitHub (25 RTC Bounty)
body:
## Bounty: 25 RTC

**Beacon 2.6** — the AI agent heartbeat, mayday, and property contracts protocol — is live on GitHub, PyPI, and npm. Help spread the word!

### Requirements

1. **Star** the repo: https://github.com/Scottcjn/beacon-skill
2. **Share or mention** beacon-skill on at least one social platform:
   - Moltbook (post to m/ai, m/rustchain, m/elyanlabs, or m/general)
   - X/Twitter (tag @RustchainPOA)
   - Dev.to article or comment
   - Hacker News, Reddit, or any tech community
   - Personal blog or newsletter
3. Your share must include:
   - A link to the repo or PyPI/npm package
   - A brief description of what Beacon does (heartbeat protocol for AI agents)

### How to Claim

1. Comment on this issue expressing interest
2. Star the repo and share on social media
3. Submit proof: screenshot of your star + link to your social post
4. RTC will be transferred to your RustChain wallet

**25 RTC per verified star + social share.** One claim per person.

### What is Beacon?

Beacon is an AI agent heartbeat and coordination protocol:
- **Heartbeat**: Agents announce presence with `beacon.ping()`
- **Mayday**: Distress signaling when agents need help
- **Contracts**: Property system (rent/buy) for AI agent resource management
- **Atlas**: City-based agent directory with valuations
